== Summary ==
Game 2 of the [[2008 US East Nationals]] final: [[Jan Westergard]] (right, maroon shirt) against [[Justin Desai]] (left, black cap). Westergard won the title.

* '''Source:''' [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2627538197/ "game2"], flickr, posted by brad227lex on 1 July 2008. flickr caption: "westergards combat racing vs desais hunt down in the finals"
* '''Original image:''' https://live.staticflickr.com/3124/2627538197_999366bba4_o.jpg (3264×2448, Kodak EasyShare M883)
* '''Date:''' 28 June 2008 (camera time 20:27)
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brad Eier]] (flickr user ''brad227lex''), chairperson of the [[2008 US East Nationals]]. The account is his: its bye-card photo is captioned "this is the card i got at yavin" and the card bears the handwritten name Brad Eier (see [[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 bye card Yavin IV Regional Brad Eier.jpg]]), and the sealed-deck caption says "we ran" the side event.
* '''Licence:''' flickr lists the photo as All Rights Reserved. Uploaded as a record of the tournament with the wiki owner's approval; credit the photographer and link the flickr page when reusing.
* '''Identification:''' flickr caption names both finalists. Westergard is the man on the right (same face and maroon shirt as the winner photos), so Desai is on the left.
